sn22.58:1.2: tathāgato bhikkhave arahaṃ sammāsambuddho rūpassa nibbidā virāgā nirodhā anupādā vimutto sammāsambuddhoti vuccati.
sn22.58:1.3: bhikkhupi bhikkhave paññāvimutto rūpassa nibbidā virāgā nirodhā anupādā vimutto paññāvimuttoti vuccati.
sn22.58:2.1: tathāgato bhikkhave arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vedanāya nibbidā virāgā nirodhā anupādā vimutto sammāsambuddhoti vuccati.
sn22.58:2.2: bhikkhupi bhikkhave paññāvimutto vedanāya nibbidā …pe… paññāvimuttoti vuccati.
sn22.58:3.3: viññāṇassa nibbidā virāgā nirodhā anupādā vimutto sammāsambuddhoti vuccati.
sn22.58:3.4: bhikkhupi bhikkhave paññāvimutto viññāṇassa nibbidā virāgā nirodhā anupādā vimutto paññāvimuttoti vuccati.
sn22.58:4.1: tatra bhikkhave ko viseso ko adhippāyaso kiṃ nānākaraṇaṃ tathāgatassa arahato sammāsambuddhassa paññāvimuttena bhikkhunāti.
sn22.58:4.2: bhagavaṃmūlakā no bhante dhammā bhagavaṃnettikā bhagavaṃpaṭisaraṇā sādhu vata bhante bhagavantaññeva paṭibhātu etassa bhāsitassa attho bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantīti.
sn22.58:4.3: tenahi bhikkhave suṇātha sādhukaṃ manasikarotha bhāsissāmīti.
sn22.58:4.4: evaṃ bhanteti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
sn22.58:5.1: tathāgato bhikkhave arahaṃ sammāsambuddho anuppannassa maggassa uppādetā asañjātassa maggassa sañjānetā anakkhātassa maggassa akkhātā maggaññū maggavidū maggakovido.
sn22.58:5.2: maggānugā ca bhikkhave etarahi sāvakā viharanti pacchā samannāgatā.
sn22.58:5.3: ayaṃ kho bhikkhave viseso ayaṃ adhippāyaso idaṃ nānākaraṇaṃ tathāgatassa arahato sammāsambuddhassa paññāvimuttena bhikkhunāti.
